name: com.pokemontcgapi/mcp
title: Pokémon TCG API
description: English, Japanese and Chinese Pokémon cards: search, sets, illustrators, prices, photo lookup.

environmentVariables.name: PTCG_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key for pokemontcgapi.com, needed by seven of the eight tools. POST /v1/accounts/free returns one without a dashboard or a card.

environmentVariables.name: PTCG_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the API base URL. Defaults to https://api.pokemontcgapi.com.
